name: Sara
description: Daughter of Raguel and Edna, of Ecbatane in Media; had been given to seven husbands, each killed by Asmodeus the evil spirit before the marriage was consummated; loosed from the spirit through Raphael and given to Tobias, her kinsman, in marriage

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
